notes: Diorama tile: 4 km x 4 km in the same orthographic tangent-plane frame as meta.json (centred on center, north up, +x = east, row 0 = north edge, pixel centres at ((i+0.5)/n - 0.5)*extent). diorama-color.webp: Murray Lab CTX mosaic V01 at native 5.0 m/px (quads E-160_N40, E-160_N36 joined into one buffer, single bicubic pass) resampled to 3.91 m/px (slight upsampling, so finest detail is ~10 m); greyscale; gentle stretch: DN 126-165 (0.5-99.5 pct) mapped linearly to 18-237, tails (1.0% of px) rolled off smoothly toward 0/255, no clipping. diorama-tint.webp: Viking MDIM 2.1 colour (Trek zoom 7, ~325 m/px), bilinear to 62.5 m/px; a near-uniform muted red-brown over 4 km (RGB ~101-117, 84-96, 86-97); use as a low-frequency colour multiplier. diorama-height.png: HRSC/MOLA blended DEM 200 m, Gaussian-smoothed (sigma 0.75 px = 150 m) on the DEM grid, then bicubic to 15.6 m/px. Only ~20 DEM samples span the tile, so it is a gentle low-frequency surface; the small craters and ripples visible in CTX have no DEM expression (derive fine relief from diorama-color.webp if needed). Metres relative to the MOLA areoid; decode metres = lo + (R*256+G)/65535*(hi-lo). Not curvature-corrected (drop at the tile corner ~r^2/2R = 1.2 m). The CTX quad boundary (40.0 N) crosses the tile at colour row ~815; both quads are tiles of one continuous mosaic on the same grid and were stitched before resampling, so there is no tonal or geometric seam.
